title: Stamp capturedAt on every captured receipt
userStory: As the app, I record WHEN a receipt was captured so calendar matching can use it later.
acceptanceCriteria: receiptCapture.takeReceiptPhoto stamps capturedAt via an INJECTED now() (default () => new Date().toISOString()); pickReceiptFromLibrary maps the picker asset's creationTime to capturedAt (null when absent).
normalizeReceipt threads capturedAt onto the returned receipt object (alongside the existing fileName/height/mimeType/source/uri/width).
npm test passes: camera receipt carries the injected ISO capturedAt; library receipt maps creationTime->capturedAt and null when absent; existing capture tests stay green.
